description: Look up a restaurant's existing bookings made with a given mobile number. Returns each booking's id (for easytable_cancel_booking) plus a summary.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

mobile.description: Mobile number the booking was made with, in E.164 (e.g. +46701234567).

name: easytable_find_bookings
